meta.name: full
meta.description: Deliver a large, cross-domain Phoenix feature or complete end-to-end system through planning, implementation, verification, and review. Use when several coordinated workflows or contexts must ship together. NOT for an existing plan; use /phx:work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并交付跨领域的 Phoenix 端到端功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要协调多个工作流并一次性交付完整 Phoenix 特性
copy.tagline_en: Plan and deliver cross-domain Phoenix features end-to-end
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple workflows and ship a complete Phoenix feature at once

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会自主完成复杂的Elixir/Phoenix功能开发，包括研究模式、制定计划、分步实现、验证测试和代码审查，并在发现问题时自动循环修正。
howto.when: 当你输入“/phx:full <功能描述>”时触发。适用于需要多个步骤或模块协同交付的情况。如果参数指向已有计划文件则跳过规划阶段。

say.note: 使用Codex CLI辅助审查，审查周期包含Codex

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude autonomously executes complete Elixir/Phoenix feature development: researches patterns, plans with specialists, implements with verification, and reviews code, automatically cycling back if issues are found.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type "/phx:full <feature description>". Use when several coordinated workflows or contexts must ship together. If the argument points to an existing plan, it skips planning.

say_en.text: /phx:full Add user authentication with magic links
say_en.note: Claude will automatically develop the authentication feature.
Codex CLI joins every review cycle.
